plain_language_question: 摄像头失效后，音频能判别狗叫和关门，却未必能区分开门和关门；模型应继续强化哪些判断？
concrete_example: TOY: 视频缺失；声音将开门/关门概率分成 0.55/0.40，狗叫 0.05。此数字仅用于理解，不是实验结果。
motivation: 视频与音频信息的缺失可能只影响某些类别对，模态级可靠性不能代替类别对证据；是否有 TTA 所致的更新伤害必须先实证。
prior_work: DASP CVPR26 对模态偏移做诊断和稳定/可塑适应 https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2026/html/He_Decoupling_Stability_and_Plasticity_for_Multi-Modal_Test-Time_Adaptation_CVPR_2026_paper.html; MiDl ICLR25 研究缺失模态 https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2025/hash/cdd0640218a27e9e2c0e52e324e25db0-Abstract-Conference.html; PASLE ICLR25 候选标签而非确定伪标签 https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2025/hash/ac662d74829e4407ce1d126477f4a03a-Abstract-Conference.html.
hypothesis: 给定相同的熵/置信度/模态质量，额外的类别对证据代理可以预测更新导致的错误增加；若不能则假设不成立。

potential_contributions.claim: 类别对证据代理能增量解释负适应
potential_contributions.required_evidence: confidence-stratified per-pair harm diagnostics across seeds
potential_contributions.nearest_prior: DASP modality diagnosis and PASLE uncertain candidate-label handling
potential_contributions.novelty_delta: pair-specific incremental prediction of adaptation-caused harm after conditioning on entropy/confidence/modality quality
potential_contributions.distinguishing_test: within matched entropy and modality quality strata, predict update-driven error flips per class pair
potential_contributions.necessity_ablation: replace pair proxy with entropy threshold and sample confidence under same update count
potential_contributions.kill_signal: proxy no better than simple controls

potential_contributions.claim: 仅在可测证据支持的关系中更新能减少坏边界被放大
potential_contributions.required_evidence: same-stack SOTA+simple rival comparisons and low-score margin drift ablation
potential_contributions.nearest_prior: DASP asymmetric update, MiDl missing-modality adaptation, PASLE candidate-label approach
potential_contributions.novelty_delta: gradient-producing loss conditioned on class-pair proxy and low-evidence margin-limiting penalty
potential_contributions.distinguishing_test: reduce source-to-TTA harmful flips without hurting high-evidence accuracy beyond freeze/skip
potential_contributions.necessity_ablation: remove pair weighting and low-evidence protective term separately
potential_contributions.kill_signal: simple skip/reset works as well or shared gradients corrupt all pairs

scientific_story: 失效模态→类别对证据损伤不均(HYPOTHESIS)→常规 TTA 在无证据边界更新(HYPOTHESIS)→可观测 pair-proxy→条件适应→与最简控制法做 paired harm 对比。

feasibility.dataset: Kinetics50-C audio/video; DASP README official reference
feasibility.model_checkpoint: CAV-MAE ks50-specific checkpoint FILE REQUIRES CONFIG INSPECTION
feasibility.baselines: Source no-update; skip-update/entropy-threshold; DASP same-stack; PASLE original code NOT automatically comparable
feasibility.evaluation_protocol: same sample ids, severity and seed, adaptation before-vs-after, class-pair confusion and confidence-conditioned negative flips
feasibility.checkpoint_mapping_status: UNVERIFIED DASP README table/directory mapping requires configs/label mapping inspection

first_48h: D0: inspect DASP readme/config/checkpoint label mapping and rights; save artifact_inventory.csv
E0: run tiny same-sample paired source/no-update and DASP; save source_predictions.csv, e0_pair_harm.csv
first_week: D1 verify license; D2 data and matched source; D3 E0; D4 score-vs-entropy calibration; D5 minimal mechanism if E0 positive; D6 rival and ablation; D7 verify STOP decision
kill_criteria: No repeatable adaptation-induced harm beyond corrupted-only Source performance
Pairwise estimator adds no value after entropy, missingness and confidence controls
Freezing or simplest confidence gate matches mechanism with same update budget
reviewer_risks: PASLE may already avoid pseudo-label collapse; a pairwise mask cannot isolate shared model gradients; source-only pair AUC does not identify individual sample information; whether zero-fill acts as missing token.
teach_back: 不是凭空恢复已经丢掉的音视频信息，而是先证明错误自适应存在，再查能否用剩余证据阻止自我强化。

method_design.task_io: audio/video modalities (tensor shapes TO_VERIFY) to event-class logits [B,C], masked missingness handled separately
method_design.baseline_decision: DASP diagnose modalities then adapt stable/plastic portions, source baseline makes no update; actual repo config mapping to verify
method_design.decision_rule: For candidate class pairs with observable evidence estimate e_ij(x)>=tau AND stable teacher ordering, use pairwise margin distillation; otherwise limit increased logit magnitude relative frozen source. Calibration tau NOT tuned on test labels.

estimator.observables: available modality flag; source pair discriminability from source validation (if permitted); no-label feature perturbation stability of logit margins
estimator.formula_or_procedure: proposed: e_ij = calibrated(source_pair_prior_ij * fraction_of_augmentations_with_stable_order_ij); prior is not sample proof and calibration data must be held out
estimator.validation_test: offline test labels ONLY for held-out diagnostic AUC and matched-error analysis; test-time update never sees y

method_design.loss_or_algorithm: L = Σ_e>=τ w*D(m_ij(theta,x),stopgrad(m_teacher_ij(x))) + λΣ_e<τ max(0,|m_ij(theta,x)|-|m_ij(frozen,x)|-δ)^2 + μ||adapter-adapter_init||²; shared gradient leakage not solved by masking alone
method_design.frozen_parameters: pretrained audio and video encoders + frozen source teacher snapshot
method_design.updated_parameters: fusion-side small adapter only, proposed injection not yet located

integration.entrypoint_status: TO_LOCATE — need to inspect repo main Python and YAML config before naming functions
integration.input_contract: floating feature/logit tensors, availability masks, allowed source prior, selected class subset
integration.output_contract: symmetric scores [B,C,C] with diagonal masked; no test labels used

update_timeline: t0: frozen source logits and unlabeled current input -> estimate class-pair scores -> compute loss -> update adapter only -> prediction
t1: new input -> snapshot teacher policy (defined/frozen) -> recompute pair scores -> update retained adapter, or reset in control condition
method_design.test_label_policy: no target labels for TTA or tuning hyperparameters; labels accessed after predictions offline for diagnostics only
method_design.source_data_policy: source validation prototype/accuracy stats allowed only if protocol explicitly permits preprocessing at training time; source-free TTA cannot use raw source at adaptation
method_design.shift_protocol: video/audio corruption vs genuine missingness use distinct masks/config; only compare if model accepts missing representation
method_design.leakage_controls: separate source validation for score priors and threshold selection; test labels only after all predictions; no per-test-label oracle gating
method_design.implementation_limitations: whether an instance-specific pairwise score is even observable is UNSOLVED, no runnable loss and no implemented integration; bounded cannot recreate physically lost info
method_design.weakest_assumption: pairwise evidence proxy adds predictive value conditional on confidence and modality reliability; cannot be measured solely by a high-confidence model
method_design.cost_scaling: dense [B,C,C] pair scores O(B*C^2) compute/memory; top-k pairs should be considered only after checking coverage and cost on real C

researcher_trial.student_blockers: DASP checkpoint table and folder labels inconsistent on sight; dataset license/download and CAV-MAE actual class mapping unknown; method estimator f must be measured
researcher_trial.reviewer_attacks: DASP already diagnoses modalities; PASLE offers uncertain candidate sets; freeze/skip could be equal; masked pair losses do not independently freeze boundaries
researcher_trial.fixes_applied: downgrade to METHOD_NOT_READY, do E0 before implementation, include entropy-stratified diagnostic, separate missingness from corruption, record shared-gradient interference
researcher_trial.remaining_unknowns: actual DASP repo entrypoint and valid checkpoint mapping; legal access, hardware, whether residual per-pair effect exists
